content.short: Phoenix is a high-performance, fully on-chain CLOB DEX on Solana, providing CEX-like speed and instant settlement.
content.description: Phoenix is a leading decentralized exchange built natively on the Solana blockchain, utilizing a fully on-chain Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) to provide a professional-grade trading experience. Developed by Ellipsis Labs, the platform features a unique "crankless" design that eliminates external bots for trade settlement, resulting in near-instant finality and deep liquidity. By leveraging Solana's high throughput and sub-second execution, Phoenix provides a transparent and non-custodial venue for asset exchange that prioritizes user sovereignty for both retail and pro traders.
content.meta: Phoenix offers professional-grade on-chain order book trading on Solana. Discover Phoenix and other DeFi Dapps on the Lancers Web3 Explorer.
